about: Refusal cases for the planning assessment overlay. Each case changes the fixture (planning-assessment-overlay.fixture.json) and names the refusal code the parsers must give. checked_by lists who must refuse it: schema (the JSON schema alone refuses the overlay), python (floodguard.planning_overlay without the protocol files gives the code), typescript (planning-assessment-overlay.ts, which always holds the protocol binding, gives the code) and python_with_protocols (the Python validator gives the code only with the two protocol files in force). Every conditional rule of the JSON schema is tripped by at least one case that both test suites run. Every value here is invented for a test.
patch_format: Each step names a row by row_id or an input by input_id (or neither, for the overlay itself), a path of keys and list positions, and either set (a value) or delete (true).
